subject: Jeffery Simmons
headline: The Bears Paid Two First-Round Picks for Jeffery Simmons and a Shot at a Title
title: Bears Land Jeffery Simmons in a Blockbuster Titans Trade
subheadline: Chicago sent its 2027 and 2028 first-round picks to Tennessee for the All-Pro defensive tackle, betting that a 5-2 start can become something bigger.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: The 5-2 Bears traded two first-round picks to Tennessee for All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, adding an elite interior rusher before Monday in Seattle.
searchIntent: Fans who heard about the trade want to know what Chicago gave up, what Simmons brings and when he could debut, with a path to Bears jerseys.
body: Teams with a 5-2 record usually make small moves at the trade deadline. The Chicago Bears made one of the biggest of the season instead, and Jeffery Simmons is the reason.

Chicago agreed on Oct. 29 to acquire the [All-Pro defensive tackle](/players/jeffery-simmons/) from the Tennessee Titans, pending a physical. The Titans receive the Bears' first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 plus a 2027 fourth-rounder. Chicago also gets a 2028 fifth-round pick back in the deal.
## What Chicago is getting

Simmons has spent his whole career in Tennessee since the Titans took him in the first round of the 2019 draft. He made four Pro Bowls there, served as a team captain five times and earned his first All-Pro selection in 2025.

He has been just as disruptive this season. Entering Week 8, he led all defensive tackles with 28 pressures, according to NFL.com. He also led the position in pressures and sacks when facing double teams, with 10 and three, and was tied for second among tackles with 21 run stops.
The Bears also take on a big contract. Simmons signed a three-year, $105.8 million extension with Tennessee in June, with $100 million guaranteed.
## Why the Bears went for it

Chicago's defensive front already had veteran Grady Jarrett, and edge rusher Montez Sweat is back from a two-game suspension. What the line lacked was a star who can collapse the pocket from the middle. Simmons fills that role, and he frees up the edge rushers around him.
For a team with [Caleb Williams](/players/caleb-williams/) at quarterback and a winning record, the message is clear: the Bears believe their window is open now, not in two years.
## A big first test

The timing makes the move even more interesting. Chicago plays the defending champion Seattle Seahawks on Monday night, Nov. 2, at Lumen Field. If Simmons is cleared to play, the national audience gets an early look at how he changes the Bears' defense.

subject: Giannis Antetokounmpo
headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo Fills the Box Score as the Heat Open the NBA Cup With 145
title: Giannis Antetokounmpo Triple-Double Powers Heat Past Pacers
subheadline: Miami's new star had 31 points, 17 rebounds and 10 assists in 31 minutes, and Klay Thompson and Bam Adebayo joined the scoring party.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Giannis Antetokounmpo posted 31 points, 17 rebounds and 10 assists as the Heat beat the Pacers 145-125 in their NBA Cup opener for a second straight win.
searchIntent: Fans looking for the details of Giannis's triple-double and Miami's big NBA Cup win, with a path to his Heat jersey.
body: It took Giannis Antetokounmpo just 31 minutes on Friday to remind everyone why Miami wanted him so badly.

The [Heat forward](/players/giannis-antetokounmpo/) finished with 31 points, 17 rebounds and 10 assists as Miami beat the Indiana Pacers 145-125 at Kaseya Center on Oct. 30. It was his second triple-double of the season and came in the Heat's first game of NBA Cup group play.
## The middle quarters decided it

Indiana came out firing and scored 42 points in the first quarter to lead by six. Then Miami took over. The Heat outscored the Pacers 67-46 across the second and third quarters and pulled away for good.

Giannis was the engine, but he had plenty of company. [Bam Adebayo](/players/bam-adebayo/) scored 27 points on 11-of-14 shooting. Klay Thompson added 25 points with seven 3-pointers, his best game since joining Miami. He now sits 55 threes behind Ray Allen's 2,973, the third-highest total in NBA history.
Pelle Larsson scored 18, and Davion Mitchell had 15 points and 11 assists.

Indiana was short-handed, with only 11 players available. Tyrese Haliburton is out with a hamstring strain, Obi Toppin was ruled out with a back injury, and assistant Lloyd Pierce coached the team while Rick Carlisle attended his father's funeral. Quenton Jackson led the Pacers with 24 points, and Andrew Nembhard scored 22.
## Why it matters for Miami

The win was Miami's second in a row after a slow start to the season. It also matters in the Cup standings: every team that has reached the knockout round has gone at least 3-1 in its four group games, so an opening win gives the Heat a strong position.

Giannis has been one of the league's most recognizable stars for years, and his first months in Miami have only added to that. Fans can see where he ranks on our [top selling NBA jerseys](/top-selling-nba-jerseys/) page.
## Up next: a trip to Los Angeles
The Heat visit the Lakers on Monday, Nov. 2. That puts Giannis on the same floor as Luka Dončić in one of the most attractive matchups of the early season.

subject: Gabby Williams
headline: Gabby Williams Has Carried the Valkyries All Series. Tonight She Gets Game 7 at Home.
title: Gabby Williams and the Valkyries Host WNBA Finals Game 7
subheadline: The series' leading scorer and a second-year franchise get a winner-take-all night at Chase Center, with a first title waiting for either side.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Gabby Williams leads the WNBA Finals in scoring as Golden State hosts Atlanta in the first Game 7 in Finals history on Oct. 31 at 8 p.m. ET at Chase Center.
searchIntent: Fans getting ready for Game 7 want to know who has driven Golden State's run and when and where the game is, with a path to Valkyries jerseys.
body: No player in the WNBA Finals has scored more than Gabby Williams. Tonight, with the championship on the line, she and the Golden State Valkyries get to play for it at home.

Golden State hosts the Atlanta Dream in Game 7 on Saturday, Oct. 31, at Chase Center. Tipoff is 8 p.m. ET (5 p.m. Pacific), with the game on USA, Peacock and CNBC. It is the first Game 7 in Finals history, since the series only became best-of-seven in 2025.
## Williams has been the constant

The [Valkyries forward](/players/gabby-williams/) is averaging 17.8 points in the Finals, the most of any player in the series. She has six 20-point games in these playoffs, tied with A'ja Wilson for the most.

Even in Thursday's 80-69 loss in Atlanta, she kept Golden State within reach. Williams led all scorers with 26 points, and 21 of them came after halftime as the Valkyries, after falling behind by as many as 25, cut the gap to eight in the fourth quarter.
## What Golden State needs

The Valkyries' bench produced only 14 points in Game 6, its lowest total of the playoffs. A bigger lift from the reserves would take pressure off Williams. Atlanta, meanwhile, has won every game in this series in which it scored at least 70 and lost every game in which it did not. Holding the Dream under that line is a simple way to frame the night for Golden State's defense.
## History either way

Both franchises are chasing their first championship. Golden State is only in its second season and earned the No. 2 seed. Atlanta, the No. 4 seed, had been swept in each of its three previous Finals trips before this run.

The Valkyries have quickly built one of the league's loudest fan bases, and Chase Center will be full of it tonight. Fans can see how the league's biggest names compare on our [top selling WNBA jerseys](/top-selling-wnba-jerseys/) page.
By the end of the night, one of these teams will hold its first trophy. If Williams keeps scoring like she has all series, Golden State likes its chances.

headline: Pete Crow-Armstrong's Peers Just Named Him Baseball's Best Player
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong Wins Players Choice Player of the Year
subheadline: The Cubs center fielder took the MLBPA's top honor and NL Outstanding Player after a 45-homer, 41-steal season, with more awards still to come.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Cubs center fielder Pete Crow-Armstrong won Players Choice Player of the Year and NL Outstanding Player after leading MLB with 45 home runs and 119 runs.
primaryKeyword: Players Choice Player of the Year
searchIntent: Fans who saw the award news want to know what Crow-Armstrong won and why, and what other honors could follow, with a path to his jersey.
body: Awards voted on by writers carry weight. An award voted on by the players who tried to get Pete Crow-Armstrong out all season says something different.

On Oct. 28, the MLB Players Association named the [Cubs center fielder](/players/pete-crow-armstrong/) its 2026 Player of the Year and the National League's Outstanding Player in the Players Choice Awards.
## The season that earned it
Crow-Armstrong led the majors with 45 home runs and 119 runs scored. He also stole 41 bases and drove in 107 runs while hitting .280 with a .372 on-base percentage and a .570 slugging percentage.
Topping 40 homers and 40 steals in the same year put him in rare company. It was only the seventh 40-40 season in MLB history, and it rewrote a large part of the Cubs' franchise record book.

That production came from a player whose glove was his calling card when he arrived in the majors. He remains one of the game's best defensive center fielders, which is why the season's value went beyond the batter's box.
## Strong company

The other headline winners show how strong the season was. Houston's Yordan Álvarez won AL Outstanding Player after leading the American League in batting average, on-base percentage and slugging. Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski, fresh off a World Series title, was named NL Outstanding Pitcher after leading the majors with a 1.80 ERA. The Yankees' Cam Schlittler took the AL pitching award.
## More hardware could follow

Award season is just getting started. Crow-Armstrong is a Gold Glove finalist, with winners revealed on Nov. 1, and a Hank Aaron Award finalist. He is widely viewed as the favorite for NL MVP, which will be announced on Nov. 12.

Fans can see how he compares with the league's biggest stars on our [top selling MLB jerseys](/top-selling-mlb-jerseys/) page. If the next two weeks go the way his season did, his trophy shelf is about to get crowded.

subject: Tage Thompson
headline: Tage Thompson Scores Three Straight Goals and Climbs the Sabres Record Book
title: Tage Thompson Natural Hat Trick Leads Sabres Past the Ducks
subheadline: Buffalo's center had three goals and two assists as the Sabres turned a 3-1 deficit into a 7-6 win in Anaheim.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Tage Thompson scored a natural hat trick and added two assists as Buffalo scored six straight goals to beat Anaheim 7-6. It was his 10th career hat trick.
searchIntent: Fans looking for details of Thompson's hat trick and the Sabres' wild win, with a path to his jersey.
body: Buffalo was down 3-1 in Anaheim on Thursday when Tage Thompson decided the night was going to be his.

The [Sabres center](/players/tage-thompson/) scored three goals in a row, a natural hat trick, and added two assists as Buffalo beat the Anaheim Ducks 7-6 at Honda Center on Oct. 29. It was the 10th hat trick of his career.
## Six goals in a row

Noah Ostlund started the comeback with a power-play goal late in the first period. Thompson tied the game at 15:32 of the first after skating around a defender. He then scored twice in the final minutes of the second period, first on a one-timer off a faceoff win at 18:36 and then on a backhand from close range just 15 seconds later.
Jack Quinn and Zach Benson scored early in the third, and Buffalo's run reached six straight goals for a 7-3 lead.

Anaheim did not go quietly. Cutter Gauthier, Tristan Luneau and Beckett Sennecke scored in the third, the last of them with 31 seconds left, but Colten Ellis and the Sabres held on. Ellis finished with 29 saves.
## A place in team history

The hat trick moved Thompson into a tie with Danny Gare and Alexander Mogilny for the third-most in Sabres history. It also tied him with Jeremy Roenick and Jimmy Carson for the sixth-most by a U.S.-born player.
The night had other bright spots for Buffalo. Roger McQueen, the 10th overall pick in the 2025 draft, scored his first NHL goal in his eighth game. Quinn now has 10 points in his last eight games.
## What comes next
The win was Buffalo's second straight and moved the Sabres to 6-4-3. They have earned points in all three games of their four-game road trip so far, with one stop left.

Thompson's size and shot have made him one of the most recognizable players in Buffalo for years. Fans can see how he stacks up against the league's [top selling NHL jerseys](/top-selling-nhl-jerseys/). If he keeps scoring like this, the Sabres could be heading home on a real roll.

subject: Liel Abada
headline: Liel Abada Needed 18 Minutes to Send Charlotte FC Back to the Playoffs
title: Liel Abada's Hat Trick Clinches Charlotte FC Playoff Spot
subheadline: Off the bench in the 65th minute, the Israeli winger scored three times in a 4-0 win over CF Montréal, the fastest hat trick in club history.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Liel Abada came off the bench and scored a hat trick within 18 minutes as Charlotte FC beat CF Montréal 4-0 to clinch a third straight MLS Cup Playoffs berth.
searchIntent: Fans looking for how Charlotte clinched and the details of Abada's quick hat trick, with a path to Charlotte FC jerseys.
body: Most substitutes hope to make one play that matters. Liel Abada made three of them in less than 20 minutes.
Charlotte FC brought the winger on in the 65th minute against CF Montréal on Oct. 28. By the 83rd minute he had a hat trick, and Charlotte had a 4-0 win that clinched a spot in the MLS Cup Playoffs.
## Three goals, 18 minutes

Abada needed only two minutes to score his first, a low shot into the bottom corner. His second came in the 79th minute after a combination with [Idan Toklomati](/players/idan-toklomati/). Four minutes later he finished from inside the box with his right foot to complete the set.
All three goals came within his first 18 minutes on the field, the fastest hat trick in club history. It was Charlotte's third regular-season hat trick, after ones by Toklomati and Daniel Ríos.
The performance earned Abada the league's Player of the Matchday award for Matchday 33. He is the seventh different Charlotte player to win it.
## A steady club keeps rising

The win sent Charlotte to the postseason for a third straight year under head coach Dean Smith. The club also joined Inter Miami as the only teams to reach at least 50 points in each of the last three regular seasons.

Abada, in his third season with Charlotte, now has career highs of eight goals, five assists and 13 goal contributions. He is the second Israel international to win Player of the Matchday this year, after D.C. United's Tai Baribo.
## Chasing a better seed

With a playoff place secured, Charlotte now turns to seeding. The club hosts Orlando City on Oct. 31, and the regular season ends on Decision Day, Nov. 7. Finishing in the top four in the East would bring home-field advantage in the first round.
